Package com.cryptocurrency.data.controller

Class TransactionController

java.lang.Object
com.cryptocurrency.data.controller.TransactionController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/portfolio") @CrossOrigin(origins="http://localhost:3000") public class TransactionController extends Object
The TransactionController class is a Spring REST controller for managing transactions. Author: Mouhamadou Ahibou DIALLO

  • Method Details

    • createTransaction

      @PostMapping("/create") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createTransaction(@RequestBody TransactionRequestService transaction)
      Creates a new transaction for a user with a specified cryptocurrency and investment amount.
      Parameters:
      transaction - A TransactionRequestService object containing userId, cryptoId, and amountInvested.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing the created Transaction object or an error message if userId or cryptoId is null.

    • updateTransaction

      @PutMapping("/update/{transactionId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateTransaction(@PathVariable Long transactionId, @RequestBody TransactionUpdateService transaction)
      Updates a transaction with a specified ID with a new investment amount.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - The ID of the transaction to be updated.
      transaction - A TransactionUpdateService object containing the new investment amount.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing the updated Transaction object or an error message if transactionId is null.

    • deleteTransaction

      @DeleteMapping("/delete/{transactionId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> deleteTransaction(@PathVariable Long transactionId)
      Deletes a transaction with the given ID.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - The ID of the transaction to be deleted.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing an error message if transactionId is null or a success message if the transaction is deleted.

    • getAllTransactions

      @GetMapping("/{userId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getAllTransactions(@PathVariable Long userId)
      Retrieves a list of all transactions associated with a given user.
      Parameters:
      userId - The ID of the user whose transactions are to be retrieved.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing a list of Transaction objects associated with the user, or an error message if userId is null.

    • getPortfolioPerformance

      @GetMapping("/performance/{userId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<PorfolioPerformance> getPortfolioPerformance(@PathVariable Long userId)
      Retrieves the performance of a user's portfolio.
      Parameters:
      userId - The ID of the user whose portfolio performance is to be retrieved.
      Returns:
      A ResponseEntity containing a PorfolioPerformance object representing the user's portfolio performance. If the performance is null, an empty PorfolioPerformance object is returned.
